name: CE_STMT_LINE_DETAILS_INT
description: CE_STMT_LINE_DETAILS_INT contains information about statement line details interface.

columns.name: STMT_LINE_DETAIL_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the statement line detail.

columns.name: STMT_LINE_INT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the statement line interface.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Point to point reference assigned by the instructing party of the underlying message.

columns.name: ACCT_SRVCR_REF
columns.description: Reference of the account servicing institution for transaction.

columns.name: INSTRUCTION_IDENTIFICATION
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by an instructing party to unambiguously identify an instructed party.

columns.name: END_TO_END_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unambiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire end-to-end chain.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identification assigned by the first instructing agent to unambiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire interbank chain.

columns.name: MANDATE_ID
columns.description: Reference of the direct debit mandate that is signed between the debtor and the creditor.

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the check number of the underlying transaction.

columns.name: CLEARING_SYSTEM_REF
columns.description: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment instruction that is assigned by the clearing system.

columns.name: PROP_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the type of proprietary reference of an underlying transaction.

columns.name: PROP_REFERENCE
columns.description: Proprietary reference specification related to the underlying transaction.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
